primary_layer.rationale: Compact multiscale scale-free vector chosen before production outcomes are viewed. It avoids duplicating many strongly correlated quantiles and threshold summaries.

residual_definition: z_j=(S_j-mu0_j)/sd0_j using same-size matched null ensemble
cross_domain_primary_endpoint: Euclidean distance between domain-level residual centroids
important: Raw spectra are never compared directly across domains.
Riemann and Neural use different symmetry-specific primary nulls.
Individual gaps are not inferential replication units.
Feature membership cannot be changed after production results are inspected without a versioned protocol amendment.
